prompt: A vertical 9:16 photograph of a narrow council-flat hallway at dusk, seen at eye level from the doorway of the front room, the painted door frame cutting into the left side of the picture. An elderly working-class British woman, about eighty, in a long brown winter coat, a burgundy knitted hat and fleece slippers, stands on a worn patterned doormat by the front door. A small pile of junk mail lies at her feet. She holds one flyer out at arm's length to read it, its face towards the camera: a sad, well-fed middle-aged man in an expensive coat above the words "SPONSOR A CHANCELLOR" in bold white sans-serif on red. She tilts her head with a look of genuine sympathy. The walls are magnolia woodchip, a draught excluder lies along the bottom of the door, and a coat hook is crowded with scarves and a shopping bag. The light is a single weak bare bulb overhead, warm and dim, against cold blue dusk through the reeded glass of the front door. Colour negative film with fine grain, low contrast, a normal lens, slightly high camera, nothing tidy. Thanks.
